records.rationale: FirstLight's current data-center page identifies its active Brunswick facility and publishes present operating specifications. records.rationale: UF's construction record defines the East Campus building as a data center with a dedicated High Performance Computing Center. UFIT's maintained history then identifies the East Campus facility as opened in 2012, HiPerGator production there from 2013, and later generations through the 2025 retirement of HiPerGator 2.0. Together the first-party records establish the mapped East Campus research-computing facility and current operation. The 2011 area figure was prospective and is not normalized.

raw_value.label: East Campus facility and later HiPerGator production history

evidence.finding: UFIT identifies the East Campus facility as opened and documents production systems and later hardware generations through 2025.

raw_value.value: East Campus data center including a dedicated High Performance Computing Center

evidence.finding: UF's construction announcement establishes the building's data-center and HPC identity; its prospective 15,000-square-foot figure is retained only as context.

raw_value.label: Building 880 Annex data center serving enterprise and HPC systems

evidence.finding: The official map identifies the exact Building 880 Annex as an operating enterprise and HPC data center available for facility tours.

raw_value.value: Current Sandia HPC meeting and training room in Building 880/A1N

evidence.finding: The maintained HPC site confirms ongoing Sandia HPC functions in the exact building, but does not separately describe the annex equipment floor.

records.rationale: SAP's 2025 first-party list establishes that a Colorado Springs data center currently operates SAP cloud services, and a local building-department record documents a data-center project at 2345 Windswept View. A directory maps the COS02 code to that address and calls it operational, but the reviewed official and operator sources do not make the code-to-building link. Under the national policy, market-level operation plus an uncorroborated directory mapping cannot establish this exact building's lifecycle status.

raw_value.value: Colorado Springs listed among data centers currently operating SAP cloud services

evidence.finding: The operator confirms current SAP data-center operation in Colorado Springs but does not identify COS02 or a street address.

raw_value.value: Data-center electrical project at 2345 Windswept View completed in 2018 project history

evidence.finding: The local record establishes a data-center project at the mapped address but does not identify SAP, COS02, or current operation.

raw_value.label: Directory-reported COS02 operational at 2345 Windswept View

evidence.finding: The directory supplies the exact code-to-address mapping but is discovery-only and cannot establish lifecycle status by itself.
